name: vigueur
description: Reliable access to French law for Claude: Légifrance and Judilibre through your own PISTE credentials, running locally.

tools.name: legifrance_get_article
tools.description: Read one article of a code, on a date

tools.name: legifrance_get_article_history
tools.description: List an article's versions and the texts that amended it

tools.name: legifrance_search_legislation
tools.description: Search codes, laws and decrees, the Journal officiel and collective agreements

tools.name: legifrance_list_changes
tools.description: List what changed in a code or a text between two dates

tools.name: legifrance_get_text
tools.description: Read a law, decree or other text

tools.name: legifrance_browse_code
tools.description: Show a code's table of contents

tools.name: legifrance_latest_jo
tools.description: Show the latest Journal officiel issues

tools.name: legifrance_list_reference_values
tools.description: List the values accepted as filters

tools.name: judilibre_search_decisions
tools.description: Search Cour de cassation and lower-court decisions

tools.name: judilibre_get_decision
tools.description: Read one Judilibre decision, whole or one part

tools.name: judilibre_list_taxonomy
tools.description: List the values Judilibre accepts as filters

tools.name: vigueur_status
tools.description: Check your credentials and which sources answer

piste_client_id.title: PISTE client ID
piste_client_id.description: OAuth client ID of your PISTE application (free account on https://piste.gouv.fr). No account yet? See https://github.com/me-no-code/vigueur-mcp/blob/main/user-docs/en/10-setup/01-piste-account.md

piste_client_secret.title: PISTE client secret
piste_client_secret.description: OAuth client secret of the same PISTE application. Stored in your system's secure credential store.

piste_production.title: Production application
piste_production.description: On for an application you created on PISTE (production); turn it off for the sandbox application PISTE creates automatically.
